Plans
 No plan was found on the pages read; the profile records that absence rather than inventing a tier.
Sitetracker publishes NO pricing. There is no /pricing page — the path 404s and no pricing, plans or packaging page appears anywhere in the site's own 542-page sitemap. The sole commercial call to action is a demo request form at /demo/ routed through /company/contact/. This is an enterprise contact-sales motion; list price, tiers, quotas and overages are all unpublished. Recorded as an honest zero, not an omission.
